records.name: Visibility of System Status
records.explanation: People need to distinguish pending work from saved results.
records.action: For an invoice editor, keep unsaved, sending, saved and failed states distinct.
records.check: Delay and fail a save; check which state the user sees and hears.
records.caution: A heuristic suggests a question to investigate; it does not establish failure or business impact by itself.
records.note_type: original application guidance; attributed to Jakob Nielsen

records.name: Match Between the System and the Real World
records.explanation: Product language should match the user's task vocabulary.
records.action: Ask a first-time customer to explain the labels on a delivery form.
records.check: Compare their interpretation with the intended meaning; revise ambiguous terminology.

records.name: User Control and Freedom
records.explanation: Users need exits and recovery from unintended actions.
records.action: Let a draft author leave a preview and return without losing edits.
records.check: Cancel midway, go back and try an accidental deletion.

records.name: Consistency and Standards
records.explanation: Repeated actions should remain recognizable across the product.

records.name: Error Prevention
records.explanation: Avoid predictable mistakes before their consequences occur.
records.action: Show the affected workspace before a bulk archive operation.

records.name: Recognition Rather than Recall

records.name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
